description: A bearded man in a grey-and-gold robe and turban holds a rolled scroll with a red wax seal while draping a heavy black robe with gold embroidery over the shoulders of a bearded man in a conical helmet-crown. Courtiers in turbans bow on both sides, an armoured guard stands at right, torches burn on the walls and a brazier glows in a pillared, arched stone hall.
